## Statement

> Write the definition or theorem precisely. Include hypotheses. If a theorem, both the statement and a one-line gloss of what it gives you.

## Intuition

What is this concept *really* doing? One paragraph in your own words. If you can't write this without copying the book, the session isn't done.

## Example

A concrete instance, worked. Prefer something you can hold in your head over something maximally general.

## Counterexample

The case that shows why a hypothesis is needed, or that fails when the assumptions are relaxed. If there isn't a natural counterexample, write *why* the concept is unconditional.

## Connection to work

Where does this show up in Bayesian modeling, Stan, pharmacometrics, or a paper you've read? One bullet is enough; "none yet" is an honest answer.
